goal:
Create Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h only for Module A (Sonic Maximizer): phase alignment and dynamic low contour.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/ for existing JUCE/DSP headers, PluginProcessor prepare/process patterns, and any MAX_LOW_FREQ / MAX_HIGH_FREQ constants
- CMakeLists.txt target layout (do not modify)
- phase goal: 3-band split, APF cascades, envelope follower, dynamic low boost; all audio state pre-allocated in prepareToPlay

Header requirements:
- Declare class SonicMaximizer (or equivalent name matching project style) with publicly callable prepare(double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) and process(...) suitable for real-time use from the audio thread
- Pre-allocated state members only (no heap ownership that reallocates in process):
  - 3-band split via juce::dsp::IIR::Filter cascades (low < MAX_LOW_FREQ, mid, high > MAX_HIGH_FREQ)
  - Cascaded 1st/2nd-order allpass filter state: 4x APF on low, 2x on mid, 0x on high
  - Envelope follower state e and alpha
  - Cached APF coefficient a and contour parameter storage (LoContour); coefficients/constants updated only in prepare or on parameter change helpers, never implied as per-sample raw param math in the header contract
- Document in comments near process that process must perform: no new/delete/resize, no locks, no juce::String work; use ScopedNoDenormals at call site or inside process as appropriate
- Include only necessary JUCE DSP headers; keep the type complete for a later .cpp implementation
- Provide clear member names for band filters, APF arrays, envelope, sampleRate cache, and parameter targets

Do not implement DSP math in this task; declarations and state layout only.

goal:
Implement Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.cpp only, matching Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/SonicMaximizer.h (authoritative API and state layout from b.1)
- Existing Source/ DSP .cpp files for prepare/process style if present

Implementation requirements (real-time-safe):
- prepare(sampleRate, samplesPerBlock): pre-allocate/reset all filter and envelope state; compute band IIR coefficients; compute APF coefficient a = (tan(pi*fc/fs) - 1)/(tan(pi*fc/fs) + 1); set envelope alpha = exp(-1/(0.05*sampleRate)); never allocate in process
- process: 3-band split (low < MAX_LOW_FREQ, mid, high > MAX_HIGH_FREQ) using juce::dsp::IIR::Filter cascades; apply cascaded allpass group-delay (4x APF low, 2x mid, 0x high); envelope e[n] = (1-alpha)*|x_low[n]| + alpha*e[n-1]; dynamic boost G_low[n] = 1 + LoContour*(e[n]/(1+e[n])); recombine bands; use ScopedNoDenormals; no new/delete/resize, no locks, no juce::String
- Recompute APF/envelope constants only in prepare or explicit parameter-change path, never per-sample from unsmoothed raw parameter reads
- Include the header and implement all declared methods

Depend on header task b.1 completing first.
